text: {"lessons":["I should set a clear reason and plan for each trade; selling Stock B at steep losses in consecutive periods was reactive and did not stop further losses.","I should avoid adding to a stock just because its price has recently risen; before buying more, consider its prospects and how large a position I already have.","I should focus on my overall portfolio and long-term apartment goal rather than monthly swings: my account value fell 4.6% in Period 10, so I should review risk and stay disciplined."]}
